parts.text: Which claim correctly continues the list?

options.text: Each term is 3 more than the one before, so the next term is 16.
Each term is 4 more than the one before, so the next term is 17.
The next term is 14, because 14 comes after 13 when counting.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The list starts at 4 and adds 3 each time, so 13 + 3 = 16.

teacher.key_rationale: The seed is 4 and the step is +3, so the next term is 16. Adding 4 misreads how many numbers sit between 4 and 7. Counting on by ones from 13 ignores the step.
